purpose: Post-hoc method development after the global-threshold subgroup audit and hierarchical Mondrian negative adoption result: test whether train-only observable context features improve subgroup stability without group-specific calibration thresholds.

development_boundary.reason: The contextual head was designed after subgroup and Mondrian evaluation results had been inspected.
development_boundary.required_next_confirmation: Any positive candidate must be frozen and confirmed on new untouched data or independently judged flood-domain data.

frozen_model_protocol.context_encoding: One-hot categories learned from outer train case families only; each dimension has an explicit other bucket.

calibration.calibration_unit: Maximum contextual-head score among incomplete variants in each calibration case family.
calibration.declaration_rule: Declare complete only when the contextual score is strictly greater than the calibration threshold.

theoretical_scope.global_statement: With the score function fixed from train only, the global calibration order statistic retains the same marginal finite-sample interpretation under case exchangeability.
theoretical_scope.subgroup_reporting: Observable subgroup results remain repeated descriptive stress checks rather than distribution-free conditional guarantees.

gate_policy: This post-hoc development experiment cannot change Gate 2 from NO-GO/SHADOW and cannot authorize CANARY or DEFAULT.
